provenance.note: Home-based program: street address, phone and provider name are not shown.

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Separate from Food and Inaccessible: There was a bottle of Clorox wipes on the floor within reach of children. This was corrected during the inspection when the wipes were moved.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Separate from Food and Inaccessible (26 TAC §747.3203(13))

occurrences.finding: Installation of Smoke Detectors: The smoke detector in the kitchen, which is a room used by children, was beeping.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation of Smoke Detectors (26 TAC §747.5113)

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: The CPSC form was last signed 5/15/24. This was corrected during the inspection when the caregiver signed the form verifying that she has reviewed the recall list.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §747.3935(b))

occurrences.finding: Personnel Records for Household Members - Orientation: One household member who was not counted in ratio was missing documentation of orientation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personnel Records for Household Members - Orientation (26 TAC §747.905(2))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: Out of four children's files reviewed, one child was missing an emergency contact, two were missing a parent's signature agreeing to the parent handbook, one was missing a health statement, two were missing immunization records, one was missing a medication administration log, and all four were missing sign-in and -out logs.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §747.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Primary Caregiver -30 Hours Annual Training: The primary caregiver did not have any trainings for the 2024-2025 training year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Primary Caregiver -30 Hours Annual Training (26 TAC §747.1303(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements-Licensing Notices: The permit renewal letter and employee list were not posted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements-Licensing Notices (26 TAC §747.401(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Installation of Smoke Detectors: Two of the smoke detectors in the home were beeping and needed new batteries. One of the smoke detector's batteries was changed during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation of Smoke Detectors (26 TAC §747.5113)

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Separate from Food and Inaccessible: There was a bottle of Clorox wipes on a counter within reach of children. This was corrected during the inspection when the bottle was moved to the top of the fridge.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Separate from Food and Inaccessible (26 TAC §747.3203(13))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: There was no fire drill recorded in February. This was corrected during the inspection when a fire drill was done and the children were able to exit the home in under three minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §747.5005(1))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Caregivers- Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR: The primary caregiver's first aid and CPR training expired in August 2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Caregivers- Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR (26 TAC §747.1303(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Animals at Center - Documentation of Vaccinations: A dog in the home had a rabies vaccination that expired in February 2025.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Animals at Center - Documentation of Vaccinations (26 TAC §747.3703(a))

occurrences.finding: Animals at Center - Documentation of Vaccinations: A cat in the home did not have any vaccination records available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Animals at Center - Documentation of Vaccinations (26 TAC §747.3703(a))

occurrences.finding: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - Required Special Topics without specific hours: The primary caregiver did not have training certificates available for review for training in SIDS and Shaken Baby Syndrome, early childhood brain development, abuse and neglect, emergency preparedness, communicable diseases, administering medication, preventing emergencies due to allergic reactions, understanding building and physical premises safety, or handling hazardous materials.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - Required Special Topics without specific hours (26 TAC §747.1309(d))

occurrences.finding: Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Drills Documentation: The dates of the most recent fire drill and tests for fire extinguishers, carbon monoxide detectors, and smoke detectors were not recorded. This was corrected during the inspection when the drills and tests were recorded.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Drills Documentation (26 TAC §747.801(7))

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit Incomplete - Guide to first aid and emergency care: The first aid kit did not have a guide to first aid.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit Incomplete - Guide to first aid and emergency care (26 TAC §747.3803(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements-Inspection Report: The home's most recent licensing report was not posted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements-Inspection Report (26 TAC §747.401(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: During the inspection, an infant was watching television. This was corrected during the inspection when the primary caregiver was informed that children under two cannot watch television and the television was turned off.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §747.2105(a))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: The children's product recall form had not been signed since 2022. This was corrected during the inspection when the primary caregiver signed a new form verifying that she reviewed the recall list.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §747.3935(b))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: Out of four children's records reviewed, two did not have the admission date and four needed updated immunization records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §747.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional: There were no infant feeding instructions for an infant who was still on formula.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §747.2321(a))

occurrences.finding: Primary Caregiver in Registered Home Qualifications - pediatric first-aid and pediatric CPR: During the inspection it was found that the primary caregiver CPR/First Aid certificate expired in December 2020.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Primary Caregiver in Registered Home Qualifications - pediatric first-aid and pediatric CPR (26 TAC §747.1007(5))

occurrences.finding: Animals at Center - Documentation of Vaccinations: During the inspection the provider did not have documentation of current vaccinations for pets in the home.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Animals at Center - Documentation of Vaccinations (26 TAC §747.3703(a))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: During the inspection the operational policies did not have a policy on the promotion of indoor/outdoor physical activities.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §747.501(8))
